description: This Java class 'AbstractFieldBsonCreator' serves as a base class for visitors that generate MongoDB BSON filter objects from expression trees within the specific context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for creating filters based on authorization data and supports different expression visiting strategies for fields and pointers.

classes.name: AbstractFieldBsonCreator
classes.description: An abstract class providing a foundation for creating BSON filters based on expressions, with support for authorization-based filtering, and handling special expression paths like ACL and global read.

methods.name: getGlobalReadBson
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for global read access based on a list of authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Abstract method to create a BSON filter for a pointer expression segment.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Abstract method to create a BSON filter for a root-level field.

methods.name: getAuthorizationBson
methods.description: Returns an optional BSON filter representing the authorization restrictions based on granted and revoked fields.

methods.name: visitAcl
methods.description: Deprecated method that throws an exception indicating ACL expressions are unsupported.

methods.name: visitGlobalReads
methods.description: Deprecated method that throws an exception indicating global read expressions are unsupported.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Determines whether the input is a pointer or root-level field and delegates to the appropriate visit method.
